name: Baguette Simulator
description: Operate private iOS simulators with Baguette, sidebar recovery controls and acknowledged keyboard input. Requires Apple Silicon, Xcode and an installed iOS runtime. Requires macOS 15.0 or newer.
whenToUse: Use only when the user explicitly selects Baguette. Run environment and devices first; reuse logged-in devices. Never take over Cindy embedded devices or automatically replace the embedded workflow. Use press(release-input) for stuck keys; heal terminates apps and requires user acceptance.

environment.description: First reject systems older than macOS 15.0. Read bundled Baguette, Xcode, available iOS runtimes and device types. Call first. Does not download dependencies.

devices.description: List only this plugin’s private device set and states. Call first; never control Cindy embedded devices.

create_device.description: Create a private simulator only when no suitable existing device is available or parallel isolation is needed. Consumes disk. Choose exact runtime and deviceType from environment; reuse logged-in devices across sessions.

boot.description: Boot the exact private device and wait for initialization, up to about 105 seconds. After timeout inspect state. Does not silently heal or restart SpringBoard.

shutdown.description: Shut down a private device, terminating running apps but preserving device data.

describe_ui.description: Read the accessibility tree with labels and logical-point coordinates. Observe before input; an empty tree is not success.

screenshot.description: Save a screenshot under the plugin screenshots directory and return its absolute path. Open with an image-view tool; analysis may send the image to the model.

heal.description: Explicitly repair iOS 27 Device Hub input failure on the private device. Restarts SpringBoard and terminates apps. Call only after the user accepts that impact; try press(release-input) for stuck keys first.

tap.description: Tap or long-press an observed position. Coordinates and screen size are logical points; observe the result afterwards.

swipe.description: Swipe between observed positions using logical-point coordinates. Observe afterwards.

type_text.description: Paste up to 8000 Unicode characters into an already focused field, replacing the simulator clipboard. Waits for key delivery and release, not App completion. Observe afterwards; use press(release-input) for repeats, never blindly retry or heal.

press.description: Press Home, lock, app switcher or notification-center controls. release-input releases stuck keyboard keys without restarting the simulator or terminating apps; observe afterwards.

install_app.description: Install an already-built local iOS Simulator .app on a private device. May replace an app with the same bundle ID. Does not build projects or download dependencies.

launch_app.description: Launch an installed app. By default also start a loopback viewer and request the current Cindy sidebar preview. Check viewer.previewOpened, not just process startup; showViewer=false leaves it in the background. User actions can change private devices: input, rotate/Shake, Home/app switching, upload/install .app, boot/shutdown (ends apps), simulate location/motion, status bar and network conditions (restore/clear in panels). Camera can use the Mac camera or uploaded media; locating can read Mac location with permission. AX/log inspection, screenshots, recording and exports may expose App data. OSM receives searches/tiles via Node. Copy overwrites Mac clipboard; paste overwrites simulator clipboard. Disclose before opening; capture/device changes require user interaction.

open_viewer.description: Open the sidebar controller and live view for a booted private device without restarting its app. Check previewOpened. Includes Recover view and Release keys buttons. Loopback only; stops when the worker exits, is disabled or has one hour of tool inactivity. User actions can change private devices: input, rotate/Shake, Home/app switching, upload/install .app, boot/shutdown (ends apps), simulate location/motion, status bar and network conditions (restore/clear in panels). Camera can use the Mac camera or uploaded media; locating can read Mac location with permission. AX/log inspection, screenshots, recording and exports may expose App data. OSM receives searches/tiles via Node. Copy overwrites Mac clipboard; paste overwrites simulator clipboard. Disclose before opening; capture/device changes require user interaction.

close_viewer.description: Stop the plugin viewer service. Browser streams disconnect; the simulator and apps keep running.
